Spanish, daily live recordings, and deleting files with Undo.

**Windows:** `Deviload-2.5.0-setup.exe`, or accept the update prompt in the app.

**Mac (test build):** accept the update prompt, or take `Deviload-2.5.0-macos-test.zip`, move it to Applications and run `xattr -cr /Applications/Deviload.app` once.

**Linux (x86_64):** `Deviload-2.5.0-amd64.deb` or `Deviload-2.5.0-x86_64.AppImage`; the AppImage updates itself.

What's new

- Spanish interface. The language menu in the top bar has English, Russian and Spanish
- Live streams on a schedule: pick a start time, a recording length and "Repeat every day", and the same stream records at the same time daily
- Removing a finished file can delete it from the disk too. It goes to the Recycle Bin or Trash, and Undo brings the task back for a few seconds
- Devil Cut exports at the original size or up to 4K, in H.264 or H.265 (about half the size), and J, K and L shuttle the preview back, stop and forward at up to 4×
- New files from Devil Cut, the converter, the audio tools and saved recordings are written under a temporary name and renamed only when complete, so a crash never leaves a broken file that looks finished
- Every bundled engine (yt-dlp, FFmpeg, Deno) is checked against the checksum its project publishes before it goes into a build
- The Inter font everywhere, the same on every system
- Deviload looks for a new version at every start and every 6 hours, not once a day
- Messages now show above open windows such as Settings
- The installer says clearly when the chosen folder needs administrator rights (anything inside Program Files) instead of failing halfway
- Support Deviload on Ko-fi, from Settings > About

Full changelog: https://github.com/Pronexsteam/deviload/compare/v2.4.0...v2.5.0
